subject: Start: Joint Success Roadmap + 60-day Evaluation — Cardinal Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Start: Joint Success Roadmap + 60-day Evaluation — Cardinal Health

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short mutual success roadmap to align on the 60-day evaluation goals, roles, and key dates. I’ve attached a first-pass draft MAP (one page) and a very short playbook that outlines what success looks like for both teams.

High-level proposal (proposal below and in the attached doc):
- Goal: Validate Redwood’s inference runtime for Cardinal’s clinical search flow with 95th percentile latency < 150ms and cost estimate for 100k monthly queries.
- Window: 60 days (start: Feb 15, target decision: Apr 15).
- Key milestones: environment access & baseline run (week 1), two evaluation scenarios (weeks 2–4), optimization pass (weeks 5–7), executive review + procurement prep (week 9).
- Roles:
  - Cardinal champion / PM: confirm requirements, coordinate test data and stakeholders (please confirm)
  - Redwood AE: Marcus Lin (me) — program lead and timeline owner
  - Redwood Solutions: Grace O’Connor — technical onboarding and benchmark run
  - Redwood Infra contact: Karthik Iyer — capacity/config and any dedicated environment setup

Please confirm the champion and any additional stakeholders we should pull into the MAP (security, procurement, platform). If the timeline looks tight, share any black-out dates. I included proposed next steps in the attached draft (Drive link below).

Next steps
- You: confirm champion & internal reviewers by Tue Feb 9
- Us: send a versioned MAP and a short checklist for environment access by Feb 12
- Schedule: 30-minute kickoff demo week of Feb 15 (I’ll send invite once we lock attendees)

Attachments: CARDINAL_MAP_DRAFT_v1.pdf (pdf, 1 page), redwood-quickstart-playbook.md (md, 2 pages)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEfGh-Cardinal-MAP

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Lena Park <lena.park@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 10:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Start: Joint Success Roadmap + 60-day Evaluation — Cardinal Health

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear plan and the draft. Mike will be my technical lead and I’ll be the program owner for the evaluation. We’ll need procurement looped by early March (expected 2–3 week review) and our security reviewer (security@cardinalhealth.com) will need an evidence pack during the optimization pass.

A couple of notes:
- We can start Feb 15 but the week of Mar 1 I’m out; if anything needs executive attention that week, please avoid.
- The most important success criteria for us: latency under 150ms p95 and compatibility with our PII redaction flow.
- I reviewed the MAP and left two comments in the Drive doc about data access requirements.

Confirming: Champion = Lena Park (program), Technical lead = Mike Reynolds.

Could you add a short line in the MAP that captures the procurement timeline? That will help me coordinate internally.

Best,
Lena
Lena Park
Director, Data Platforms — Cardinal Health
lena.park@cardinalhealth.com | (312) 555-3344

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@cardinalhealth.com>, security@cardinalhealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Start: Joint Success Roadmap + 60-day Evaluation — Cardinal Health

Lena — thanks for confirming and for the heads-up on the March 1 week. I updated the MAP to include a procurement lane with a placeholder for expected review windows and the security evidence checkpoint during optimization. New attachments: CARDINAL_MAP_DRAFT_v2.pdf (updated with procurement lane) — attached and in Drive.

Grace, Karthik — looping you both for two asks:
1) Grace: can you own the first benchmark run and the setup checklist?
2) Karthik: can you confirm whether we’ll need a dedicated sandbox or whether the hosted eval will suffice (cost + expected throughput)?

Mike — glad to have you on the thread. Apologies for the cross-timezones but we’ll aim for a 30-min kickoff the week of Feb 15; Marcus will propose options after Lena shares attendee availability.

Attachments: CARDINAL_MAP_DRAFT_v2.pdf (pdf, 1 page)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEfGh-Cardinal-MAP

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Start: Joint Success Roadmap + 60-day Evaluation — Cardinal Health

Folks — quick confirmation from my side: I reviewed the MAP v2 in Drive. Two quick asks before kickoff:
1) Can you include a short runbook for the PII redaction checks we’ll run during scenario 2? I can share an example test harness used internally.
2) For the environment, a hosted eval is preferred unless Redwood sees a blocking limitation. If you need a sandbox, flag that ASAP so procurement can scope any contract language.

I’m available for the kickoff on Mon Feb 15 at 10:00am ET or Tue Feb 16 at 2:00pm ET. Either works for me.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Mike
Lead Engineer, Data Platforms — Cardinal Health
